comments.author: Vi
comments.html: Actually you can tell who the superficial creeps are by the way they look at *you*, or at other people- which isn’t quite the same thing as judging someone by their looks. Just sayin’.

comments.author: Number 57320
comments.html:
While it may not be the same thing as judging someone by their looks, it is pretty close. I mean, you are assuming that you can read their mind: that you know exactly what they’re looking at, why they’re looking at it, and what they’re thinking about it. I know that I probably look like I’m casting judgmental stares when I’m actually just spacing out, as I have a habit of following moving things (including people) with my eyes when I’m not paying attention.

All of this is besides the point, though, as this strip is about hypocrites, not superficial creeps.
